box-sizing: border-box; font-size: 0; text-align: center; color: #000000;

display: inline-block; font-size: 11px; font-family: Inter, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif; color: var(--ge-adaptive-fg, #000000); line-height: 1.2; pointer-events: all; white-space: normal; word-wrap: normal;

div.div:
/rfe-split
--type {t} (rfe or initiative)
--headless (no summary)
one or more {ID} args
tools: Bash, Agent, Skill

div.style: display: flex; align-items: unsafe flex-start; justify-content: unsafe center; width: 208px; height: 1px; padding-top: 125px; margin-left: 222px;
box-sizing: border-box; font-size: 0; text-align: center; color: #000000;

div.div:
Step 0 - Resolve Type
bootstrap.sh --layout links scripts/, types/
type_registry.py resolve --type {t} {IDs}
launch-vars {type} split -> launch block
no IDs -> print usage and stop

div.style: display: flex; align-items: unsafe flex-start; justify-content: unsafe flex-start; width: 230px; height: 1px; padding-top: 335px; margin-left: 216px;
box-sizing: border-box; font-size: 0; text-align: left; color: #000000;

display: inline-block; font-size: 10px; font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', 'Courier New', monospace; color: var(--ge-adaptive-fg, #000000); line-height: 1.2; pointer-events: all; white-space: normal; word-wrap: normal;

div.div:
launch-vars {type} split
{TASKS_DIR} = artifacts/rfe-tasks
{REVIEWS_DIR} = artifacts/rfe-reviews
{STATE_PREFIX} = {POLL_PREFIX} = ""
{RESPLIT_FIELD} = right_sized
{RESPLIT_BELOW} = 2
{INDEX_ENABLED} = true
{SPLIT_RULES_PATH} =
types/rfe/prompts/split-rules.md
initiative: artifacts/initiatives,
artifacts/initiative-reviews,
prefixes "initiative-", index false

div.style: display: flex; align-items: unsafe flex-start; justify-content: unsafe center; width: 203px; height: 1px; padding-top: 133px; margin-left: 482px;
box-sizing: border-box; font-size: 0; text-align: center; color: #000000;

display: inline-block; font-size: 11px; font-family: Inter, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif; color: var(--ge-adaptive-fg, #000000); line-height: 1.2; pointer-events: all; white-space: normal; word-wrap: normal;

div.div:
Persist Flags + IDs
state.py init tmp/{STATE_PREFIX}split-config.yaml
type={TYPE} headless=true/false
state.py write-ids {STATE_PREFIX}split-all-ids.txt
survives context compression

div.style: display: flex; align-items: unsafe flex-start; justify-content: unsafe center; width: 198px; height: 1px; padding-top: 23px; margin-left: 717px;
box-sizing: border-box; font-size: 0; text-align: center; color: #000000;

display: inline-block; font-size: 11px; font-family: Inter, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif; color: var(--ge-adaptive-fg, #000000); line-height: 1.2; pointer-events: all; white-space: normal; word-wrap: normal;

div.div:
Report + Skip
ID listed under PENDING_IDS
no {TASKS_DIR}/{ID}.md on disk
no split agent launched

div.style: display: flex; align-items: unsafe center; justify-content: unsafe center; width: 178px; height: 1px; padding-top: 203px; margin-left: 727px;
box-sizing: border-box; font-size: 0; text-align: center; color: #000000;

display: inline-block; font-size: 12px; font-family: Inter, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif; color: var(--ge-adaptive-fg, #000000); line-height: 1.2; pointer-events: all; white-space: normal; word-wrap: normal;
display: flex; align-items: unsafe flex-start; justify-content: unsafe center; width: 228px; height: 1px; padding-top: 125px; margin-left: 947px;
box-sizing: border-box; font-size: 0; text-align: center; color: #000000;

display: inline-block; font-size: 11px; font-family: Inter, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif; color: var(--ge-adaptive-fg, #000000); line-height: 1.2; pointer-events: all; white-space: normal; word-wrap: normal;

div.div:
Split Agent (1 per ID)
Agent, model opus, background
prompt = {SPLIT_RULES_PATH}
subs {ID}, {TASK_FILE}, {REVIEW_FILE}
gaps -> atomic capabilities
next_rfe_id.py allocates child IDs
writes children, archives parent

div.style: display: flex; align-items: unsafe flex-start; justify-content: unsafe flex-start; width: 235px; height: 1px; padding-top: 115px; margin-left: 1241px;
box-sizing: border-box; font-size: 0; text-align: left; color: #000000;

display: inline-block; font-size: 10px; font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', 'Courier New', monospace; color: var(--ge-adaptive-fg, #000000); line-height: 1.2; pointer-events: all; white-space: normal; word-wrap: normal;

div.div:
{REVIEWS_DIR}/{ID}-split-status.yaml
written by the split agent, read with
yaml.safe_load - action is the key
status: completed
action: split
reason: "split into N children"
children: [RFE-003, RFE-004]
status: completed
action: no-split
reason: "delivery-coupled"
absent file = split_failed error

div.style: display: flex; align-items: unsafe flex-start; justify-content: unsafe center; width: 228px; height: 1px; padding-top: 535px; margin-left: 947px;
box-sizing: border-box; font-size: 0; text-align: center; color: #000000;

display: inline-block; font-size: 11px; font-family: Inter, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif; color: var(--ge-adaptive-fg, #000000); line-height: 1.2; pointer-events: all; white-space: normal; word-wrap: normal;

div.div:
Poll the Split Wave
state.py write-ids {POLL_FILE_PREFIX}split.txt
check_review_progress.py --phase {POLL_PREFIX}split
sleep NEXT_POLL until COMPLETED changes
no status file -> frontmatter.py set error=split_failed

div.style: display: flex; align-items: unsafe center; justify-content: unsafe center; width: 178px; height: 1px; padding-top: 613px; margin-left: 727px;
box-sizing: border-box; font-size: 0; text-align: center; color: #000000;

display: inline-block; font-size: 12px; font-family: Inter, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif; color: var(--ge-adaptive-fg, #000000); line-height: 1.2; pointer-events: all; white-space: normal; word-wrap: normal;
display: flex; align-items: unsafe flex-start; justify-content: unsafe center; width: 214px; height: 1px; padding-top: 730px; margin-left: 709px;
box-sizing: border-box; font-size: 0; text-align: center; color: #000000;

display: inline-block; font-size: 11px; font-family: Inter, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif; color: var(--ge-adaptive-fg, #000000); line-height: 1.2; pointer-events: all; white-space: normal; word-wrap: normal;

div.div:
Mark for Revision
frontmatter.py set {REVIEWS_DIR}/{ID}-review.md recommendation=revise
same for action: split with 0 children
reason kept for the final summary

div.style: display: flex; align-items: unsafe flex-start; justify-content: unsafe center; width: 213px; height: 1px; padding-top: 560px; margin-left: 482px;
box-sizing: border-box; font-size: 0; text-align: center; color: #000000;

display: inline-block; font-size: 11px; font-family: Inter, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif; color: var(--ge-adaptive-fg, #000000); line-height: 1.2; pointer-events: all; white-space: normal; word-wrap: normal;

div.div:
Collect Children
collect_children.py {TYPE_FLAG} {split_IDs}
matches parent_key, skips status: Archived
prints {ID}:child1,child2

div.style: display: flex; align-items: unsafe center; justify-content: unsafe center; width: 208px; height: 1px; padding-top: 613px; margin-left: 27px;
box-sizing: border-box; font-size: 0; text-align: center; color: #000000;

display: inline-block; font-size: 11px; font-family: Inter, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif; color: var(--ge-adaptive-fg, #000000); line-height: 1.2; pointer-events: all; white-space: normal; word-wrap: normal;

div.div:
/rfe-review (inline Skill)
--headless --caller split {TYPE_FLAG}
full agent-delegation review
writes {child}-review.md

div.style: display: flex; align-items: unsafe flex-start; justify-content: unsafe center; width: 658px; height: 1px; padding-top: 885px; margin-left: 12px;
box-sizing: border-box; font-size: 0; text-align: center; color: #000000;

display: inline-block; font-size: 12px; font-family: Inter, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif; color: var(--ge-adaptive-fg, #000000); line-height: 1.2; pointer-events: all; font-weight: bold; white-space: normal; word-wrap: normal;

div.div:
Step 3 - Right-sizing Self-Correction (max 1 cycle)
capped at 1: repeated re-splitting compounds child count (5 -> 9) for diminishing returns;
a decomposition still wrong after one correction needs human judgement.
Corrects grouping mistakes only - every other criterion is /rfe-review's auto-revision.

div.style: display: flex; align-items: unsafe flex-start; justify-content: unsafe center; width: 198px; height: 1px; padding-top: 975px; margin-left: 32px;
box-sizing: border-box; font-size: 0; text-align: center; color: #000000;

display: inline-block; font-size: 11px; font-family: Inter, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif; color: var(--ge-adaptive-fg, #000000); line-height: 1.2; pointer-events: all; white-space: normal; word-wrap: normal;

div.div:
Cycle Counter
state.py set-default correction_cycle=0
collect_children.py --ids-file re-derives
set correction_cycle={N+1} per cycle

div.style: display: flex; align-items: unsafe flex-start; justify-content: unsafe center; width: 198px; height: 1px; padding-top: 975px; margin-left: 252px;
box-sizing: border-box; font-size: 0; text-align: center; color: #000000;

display: inline-block; font-size: 11px; font-family: Inter, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif; color: var(--ge-adaptive-fg, #000000); line-height: 1.2; pointer-events: all; white-space: normal; word-wrap: normal;

div.div:
Read Child Scores
frontmatter.py read
{REVIEWS_DIR}/{child}-review.md
scores.{RESPLIT_FIELD}

div.style: display: flex; align-items: unsafe center; justify-content: unsafe center; width: 178px; height: 1px; padding-top: 1033px; margin-left: 472px;
box-sizing: border-box; font-size: 0; text-align: center; color: #000000;

display: inline-block; font-size: 12px; font-family: Inter, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif; color: var(--ge-adaptive-fg, #000000); line-height: 1.2; pointer-events: all; white-space: normal; word-wrap: normal;

display: inline-block; font-size: 11px; font-family: Inter, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif; color: var(--ge-adaptive-fg, #000000); line-height: 1.2; pointer-events: all; white-space: normal; word-wrap: normal;

div.div:
Step 4 - Finalize
frontmatter.py rebuild-index if {INDEX_ENABLED}
state.py read {STATE_PREFIX}split-config.yaml
cycle 1 already used -> report what is left

div.style: display: flex; align-items: unsafe center; justify-content: unsafe center; width: 178px; height: 1px; padding-top: 1033px; margin-left: 965px;

display: inline-block; font-size: 12px; font-family: Inter, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif; color: var(--ge-adaptive-fg, #000000); line-height: 1.2; pointer-events: all; white-space: normal; word-wrap: normal;

div.div:
Headless Exit
prints "rfe-split step completed."
no summary, caller drives the rest

div.style: display: flex; align-items: unsafe flex-start; justify-content: unsafe center; width: 213px; height: 1px; padding-top: 1060px; margin-left: 1195px;
box-sizing: border-box; font-size: 0; text-align: center; color: #000000;

div.div:
## Split Complete
original {KEY_EXAMPLE} (archived)
new {ENTITY_PLURAL}: title, priority, PASS
coverage of the original scope
no-split reason per parent
next: /rfe-submit --type {TYPE}
